name: infer-conventions
title_zh: Laravel 代码库活体公约提取器
tagline_zh: 新成员问『Form Request 还是 inline 验证』时不用再翻 10 个 PR——它扫一遍现有代码。
tagline_en: Stop answering 'Form Request or inline?' by digging old PRs—it scans your Laravel codebase, distills real.
desc_en: Use this skill to analyze how a Laravel application is actually written and record its conventions as shared rules. Trigger when the user wants to detect, infer, document, or standardize project conventions or coding style, set up or grow `.ai/rules`, resolve mixed or conflicting patterns (e.g. \"are we using Form Requests or inline validation?\"), or onboard agents and teammates to \"how we do th
why_zh: 不是让你写规则，而是从代码里『读』出规则。它识别冲突模式并给出裁决，让约定随代码演进。
why_en: It doesn't ask you to write rules—it reads them from code. Detects conflicting patterns, proposes resolutions, and keeps.
limit_zh: 只认 Laravel/PHP 项目；需要能访问 git 历史和源码目录。它产出 .ai/rules 文本。
limit_en: Laravel/PHP only; needs git history & source access. Outputs .ai/rules text—won't refactor code, and ignores non-Laravel or cross-language.
title_en: Laravel convention extractor that onboards agents to your.
